name: python-permission-model
title: Roles, scopes and conditions with an explainable deny
blurb: An authorisation decision you can read out loud: which role the subject holds on this resource, which rule won, and why every other rule lost. Deny always outranks allow, a role only applies inside its scope, `*` is one segment and `**` is the rest, and a condition that mentions an attribute nobody sent is not a match. The policy is validated before it answers: cycles, unknown roles and duplicate rule ids are errors, not surprises at request time.
default_description: Explainable RBAC/ABAC decisions with deny precedence and scoped roles.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
